_comment: Enforced by the agentic-code plugin's guard hook on every shell command Claude runs in this project. 'match' and 'unless' are Python regular expressions, searched in the whole command text. action: deny (blocked) or ask (the user confirms). EAS build/submit is deliberately not listed (see docs/decisions.md); CLAUDE.md still requires explicit permission for it.

rules.name: push to the default branch
rules.reason: Never push to main; everything goes through a branch and a pull request.
